# 2025 Portland State Vikings football team

The 2025 Portland State Vikings football team will represent Portland State University as a member of the Big Sky Conference during the 2025 NCAA Division I FCS football season. The Vikings will be coached by eleventh-year head coach Bruce Barnum and play at the Hillsboro Stadium in Hillsboro, Oregon.
